name: Alex Padilla
stance: Supports nationwide AI safeguards including independent audits, transparency and whistleblower protections, and urged a U.S.-China AI safety agreement including a possible mutual pause.

statements.text: Cosponsored the States' Right to Regulate AI Act, introduced by Sen. Markey, to prohibit implementation of the executive order that seeks to block states from regulating AI.
Americans deserve independent audits, transparency, whistleblower protections, and real accountability. It’s time to get this done nationwide.
That’s why I joined @ChrisVanHollen in urging Trump to seek a U.S.-China agreement on AI safety, including a possible mutual pause to address guardrails around its use and biological weapons risks.
